result_detail_policy: Canonical source and unique helpers; no duplicate run source snapshots. Keep human reports and their lightweight charts/tables; no videos, weights, datasets, tensors, complete request streams, environments or caches.
bulk_exclusions: Filename/directory exclusions are counted without one row per raw file; shared assets and environments are not exhaustively inventoried.
experiment_scope: All versions: designs and final analysis reports, including v1/v2. V1/v2 intermediate outputs and machine audits omitted. Selected lightweight run summaries primarily v3.0 onward.
